note: Export side is factually confirmed: real outbound customs shipments from JNPT to Hamburg, Germany, dated 2025-05-05, with HS 84821012 / 84822012 / 84822013 and B/L numbers 7943489, 1672764, 7833411, 9090268, 7459748 — i.e. tapered roller bearings, not the declared 848320/870870/870899. Declared HS 848220 is consistent with the observed records; the other declared codes (848320, 870870, 870899) were not seen in the visible rows. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split was obtained, so domestic_status is 'unknown' with null evidence rather than a guess.
